light-up-senoia-parade.details_html:
Event Overview

Get ready to celebrate the most wonderful time of the year at our annual Light Up Senoia Parade! This cherished tradition brings the community together for an evening of festivities and Christmas cheer! Parade begins promptly at 6:30pm. This is a wonderful way to promote your business and have some holiday fun!

Event Highlights

  • Festive Floats by local businesses, schools, churches, and organizations
  • Dance Groups
  • Cheerful Music & Holiday Entertainment
  • Food Trucks
  • Santa Claus
  • Santa's Workshop
  • Main Street Tree Lighting
  • Awards & Trophies
  • & More!

Event Schedule

4:00pm: Santa's Workshop Opens! Located at the Senoia Farmers' Market, 40 Travis Street

4:15pm: Pre parade entertainment begins in front of the stage on Main Street

4:30pm-5:30pm: Check in for parade participants (further details below)

6:00pm: Santa's Workshop Closes, making your way towards Main Street for the parade!

6:30pm: PARADE BEGINS

The Light Up Senoia tree lighting will immediately follow the parade. And then Santa will receive visitors on his sleigh until 8:30.

REGISTER TO SUBMIT AN ENTRY IN THE PARADE

The theme for this year's parade is "Christmas Through the Decades". All parade entries will be judged with the theme as the basis for trophy awards. The following category winners will receive a trophy.

  • Mayor's trophy (best overall entry)
  • Grand Marshal's trophy (best creative entry)
  • Santa's trophy (best Christmas Spirit)
  • Rudolph's trophy (best lighted entry)
  • Reindeer trophy (best musical/vocal/dance entry)

With it being nighttime, we encourage lights! It will be dark when the parade starts, so use those LIGHTS!!! (You will supply all electricity for your entry) Be creative! Please have some type of banner in front of your entry announcing your group's name.

You CAN NOT have a SANTA on your float, Santa will be at the end of the parade on his Fire Truck.

Please…no items can be thrown from parade participants! You may have someone walking beside your entry to hand out candy, beads etc. This is for the safety of the children. Thank you for your cooperation.

There is a $20 fee for each parade entry.

CHECK IN TIME FOR PARADE PARTICIPANTS BEGINS AT 4:30 AND ENDS AT 5:30!

You will receive multiple emails the week of the parade that will give you all information you need to know beforehand. Please make sure the email you use on the entry form is monitored, AND please put info@enjoysenoia.com in your contact list so your instructions don't end up in your junk file.

Entries are limited. Sign up NOW!

If you have questions about the parade please email: lightupsenoia@enjoysenoia.com

2026-senoia-candlelight-tour-of-homes.details_html:
Event Overview

Join us Sunday, December 13, from 3:00 to 8:00 PM for Senoia's annual Candlelight Christmas Tour of Homes. This year's tour has 8 stops.

Tickets

Tickets are $30 and go on sale Saturday, October 31 at 8 AM.

Tour Booklet Pickup

Pick up your tour booklet at the Senoia Welcome Center, 68 Main Street, beginning Monday, December 7.

Welcome Center hours: Monday through Saturday, 11 AM to 6 PM, and Sunday beginning at noon. Phone: (770) 727-9173.

Please Don't Buy or Sell Tickets Online

Do not sell or trade Tour of Homes tickets online. Please coordinate with Senoia Welcome Center staff instead. Too many people have been scammed trying to buy or sell tickets on Facebook.
